method: Built-in image_gen; matching carrying sheets using their own empty-hand identity references.

entries.name: customer_student
entries.prompt:
Create a matching PIXEL ART PARCEL-CARRY WALK ANIMATION SHEET for the EXACT character in FIRST reference: young East Asian student with fluffy brown hair, round black glasses, mustard-yellow hoodie, navy trousers, white trainers with brown soles, dark-brown backpack remains on back. SECOND reference is ONLY the game's two-handed parcel posture. Preserve FIRST reference's exact face, hair, clothes, colors, proportions and walk frames. Change empty arms to carrying ONE medium brown cardboard parcel steadily with BOTH hands in front of waist/chest in every frame. Blank cream label, same parcel size, visible hand contact. In BACK view the box is correctly occluded in front of torso; do NOT draw a parcel on back. Keep any existing backpack separately intact.
EXACTLY8 columns x4 rows=32 full-body pixel sprites on solid flat #00FF00 green, no green clothing. Row1 DOWN/front; row2 LEFT/profile; row3 RIGHT/profile; row4 UP/back. Each row is eight chronological smooth walk phases: left wide contact, down, narrow passing, up, opposite right contact, down, opposite narrow passing, up. Frames3 and7 legs close together below body;1 and5 wide opposite strides. Feet actually alternate, not static copies. Each entire figure, parcel and footwear centered inside its own uniform cell, generous green gutters, stable floor baseline, consistent size acrossall32. Chunky square pixels, dark outline, limited readable shading, compact2.5-head proportions, slightly elevated orthographic top-down RPG view. Match first reference pixel density. No anti-aliasing, no painterly look, no isometric view, no text, gridlines, labels, borders, ground shadow or scenery.
